metrics.name: up
metrics.notes: Universal Prometheus scrape health metric. 1 = target up, 0 = target down. First thing to check in any outage.

metrics.name: kube_pod_status_phase
metrics.notes: Primary metric for pod lifecycle state. phase label values: Pending, Running, Succeeded, Failed, Unknown

metrics.name: kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason
metrics.notes: Identifies why containers are stuck waiting. Common reasons: CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, ContainerCreating, ErrImagePull

metrics.name: kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total
metrics.notes: High restart counts indicate instability - crashlooping, OOM kills, or liveness probe failures

metrics.name: kube_pod_container_resource_requests
metrics.notes: Resource requests declared by containers. Use with actual usage to calculate utilization ratios

metrics.name: kube_pod_container_resource_limits
common_promql_patterns: sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes) / sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"})
metrics.notes: Resource limits declared by containers. Compare against actual usage to detect saturation risk

metrics.name: kube_pod_info
metrics.notes: Info metric for joining pod metadata (node, IP, owner) with other metrics

metrics.name: kube_pod_owner
metrics.notes: Identifies pod ownership chain for correlating issues back to workload controllers

metrics.name: kube_deployment_status_replicas_available
metrics.notes: Number of available replicas. Compare with spec_replicas to detect partial outages

metrics.name: kube_deployment_status_replicas_unavailable
metrics.notes: Number of unavailable replicas. Non-zero indicates deployment health issue

metrics.name: kube_deployment_spec_replicas
metrics.notes: Desired replica count from deployment spec. Useful for calculating availability ratios

metrics.name: kube_deployment_status_observed_generation
metrics.notes: Tracks whether controller has processed latest spec. Mismatch indicates rollout in progress or stuck

metrics.name: kube_deployment_status_condition
metrics.notes: Deployment conditions: Available, Progressing, ReplicaFailure. Check status=false for issues

metrics.name: kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready
metrics.notes: Ready replicas in statefulset. Critical for stateful workloads like databases

metrics.name: kube_statefulset_replicas
metrics.notes: Desired replica count from statefulset spec

metrics.name: kube_daemonset_status_number_available
metrics.notes: Number of nodes with available daemonset pod. Compare with desired for coverage gaps

metrics.name: kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled
metrics.notes: Number of nodes that should be running the daemonset pod

metrics.name: kube_daemonset_status_number_misscheduled
metrics.notes: Number of nodes running daemonset pod that shouldn't be. Indicates scheduling issues

metrics.name: kube_job_status_active
metrics.notes: Number of actively running pods for the job

metrics.name: kube_job_failed
metrics.notes: Number of pods which reached Failed phase. Indicates job execution failures

metrics.name: kube_job_status_start_time
metrics.notes: Unix timestamp when job started. Use to detect long-running jobs

metrics.name: kube_node_status_condition
metrics.notes: Node conditions: Ready, MemoryPressure, DiskPressure, PIDPressure, NetworkUnavailable. Critical for cluster health

metrics.name: kube_node_status_allocatable
metrics.notes: Allocatable resources on node (total minus system reserved). Use for capacity planning

metrics.name: kube_node_spec_unschedulable
metrics.notes: Whether node is cordoned. 1 = unschedulable (cordoned)

metrics.name: kube_node_spec_taint
metrics.notes: Node taints that affect scheduling. Watch for NoSchedule and NoExecute effects

metrics.name: kube_persistentvolumeclaim_status_phase
metrics.notes: PVC binding status. phase: Pending, Bound, Lost. Pending PVCs block pod startup

metrics.name: kube_persistentvolume_status_phase
metrics.notes: PV lifecycle phase: Available, Bound, Released, Failed. Failed PVs need attention

metrics.name: kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_status_current_replicas
metrics.notes: Current replica count managed by HPA

metrics.name: kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_spec_max_replicas
metrics.notes: Maximum replica limit for HPA. Hitting max indicates potential capacity issue

metrics.name: kube_poddisruptionbudget_status_current_healthy
metrics.notes: Current number of healthy pods vs PDB requirements. Below desired blocks voluntary disruptions

metrics.name: kube_resourcequota
metrics.notes: Resource quota usage vs limits. type: hard (limit) or used (current). High usage blocks new workloads

metrics.name: apiserver_request_total
metrics.notes: API server request count. Primary role is traffic; can filter by code for errors. Excludes long-running requests like WATCH

metrics.name: apiserver_request_duration_seconds
metrics.notes: API server request latency. Exclude WATCH/LIST for meaningful percentiles. High latency affects entire cluster

metrics.name: apiserver_current_inflight_requests
metrics.notes: Currently in-flight requests. request_kind: mutating or readOnly. Approaching limit (default 400/400) causes throttling

metrics.name: apiserver_longrunning_requests
metrics.notes: Active long-running requests (WATCH, CONNECT). High numbers may indicate webhook issues or stuck connections

metrics.name: apiserver_response_sizes
metrics.notes: Response size distribution. Large responses (LIST without pagination) can cause memory issues

metrics.name: apiserver_admission_controller_admission_duration_seconds
metrics.notes: Admission controller latency. Slow admission (especially webhooks) delays all API operations

metrics.name: apiserver_admission_webhook_admission_duration_seconds
metrics.notes: External admission webhook latency. Webhook failures/slowness are common causes of API server issues

metrics.name: apiserver_request_terminations_total
metrics.notes: Requests terminated due to timeout or server shutdown. Indicates overload or graceful shutdown

metrics.name: apiserver_requested_deprecated_apis
metrics.notes: Deprecated APIs being actively used. Important for upgrade planning

metrics.name: apiserver_client_certificate_expiration_seconds
metrics.notes: Time until client certificates expire. Expiring certs cause authentication failures

metrics.name: aggregator_unavailable_apiservice_total
metrics.notes: Unavailable API services (custom API servers, metrics-server). Blocks dependent functionality

metrics.name: kubelet_running_pods
metrics.notes: Number of pods currently running on the kubelet. Useful for load distribution analysis

metrics.name: kubelet_running_containers
metrics.notes: Number of containers by state (running, exited, created)

metrics.name: kubelet_pleg_relist_duration_seconds
metrics.notes: PLEG (Pod Lifecycle Event Generator) relist latency. >3s causes node NotReady condition. Critical kubelet health metric

metrics.name: kubelet_pod_worker_duration_seconds
metrics.notes: Time to sync pod. operation_type: create, update, sync. High values indicate slow container runtime

metrics.name: kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes
metrics.notes: Available bytes on mounted volume. Critical for detecting PVC exhaustion before pod eviction

metrics.name: kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes
metrics.notes: Total capacity of mounted volume in bytes

metrics.name: kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes
metrics.notes: Used bytes on mounted volume

metrics.name: kubelet_volume_stats_inodes_free
metrics.notes: Free inodes on volume. Inode exhaustion prevents file creation even with free space

metrics.name: kubelet_evictions
metrics.notes: Pod evictions triggered by kubelet. eviction_signal: memory.available, nodefs.available, imagefs.available, pid.available

metrics.name: kubelet_certificate_manager_client_ttl_seconds
metrics.notes: TTL of kubelet client certificate. Expiration causes kubelet to lose API server connectivity

metrics.name: scheduler_pending_pods
metrics.notes: Pending pods by queue: active, backoff, unschedulable, gated. Non-zero unschedulable indicates resource exhaustion or constraints

metrics.name: scheduler_schedule_attempts_total
metrics.notes: Scheduling attempts by result: scheduled, unschedulable, error. Error rate indicates scheduler issues

metrics.name: scheduler_scheduling_attempt_duration_seconds
metrics.notes: E2E scheduling latency including algorithm and binding. High values delay pod startup

metrics.name: scheduler_preemption_attempts_total
metrics.notes: Preemption attempts indicate resource contention - higher priority pods evicting lower priority ones

metrics.name: scheduler_queue_incoming_pods_total
metrics.notes: Pods entering scheduling queue. event: PodAdd, NodeAdd, etc. High rate indicates deployment activity

metrics.name: workqueue_depth
metrics.notes: Current queue depth per controller. Sustained high depth indicates controller falling behind

metrics.name: workqueue_adds_total
metrics.notes: Rate of items added to workqueue. Spike indicates burst of changes for controller to process

metrics.name: workqueue_queue_duration_seconds
metrics.notes: Time items spend waiting in queue before processing. High values indicate controller backlog

metrics.name: workqueue_work_duration_seconds
metrics.notes: Time to process each work item. High values indicate slow reconciliation

metrics.name: workqueue_retries_total
metrics.notes: Retry count indicates reconciliation failures. High retry rate suggests persistent issues

metrics.name: workqueue_unfinished_work_seconds
metrics.notes: How long in-progress work has been running. High values indicate stuck or very slow processing

metrics.name: workqueue_longest_running_processor_seconds
metrics.notes: Duration of longest running work item. Identifies stuck reconciliation loops

metrics.name: etcd_server_has_leader
metrics.notes: Whether etcd has a leader. 0 = no leader = cluster cannot process writes. Critical availability metric

metrics.name: etcd_server_leader_changes_seen_total
metrics.notes: Leader election churn. Frequent changes indicate network issues, clock skew, or resource contention

metrics.name: etcd_server_proposals_committed_total
metrics.notes: Total consensus proposals committed. Measures write throughput through raft

metrics.name: etcd_server_proposals_pending
metrics.notes: Pending raft proposals. High count indicates leader unable to commit - disk, network, or quorum issues

metrics.name: etcd_server_proposals_failed_total
metrics.notes: Failed raft proposals (lost quorum). Any failures indicate serious cluster issues

metrics.name: etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds
metrics.notes: WAL fsync latency. >10ms p99 indicates slow disk. etcd requires fast storage for consistency

metrics.name: etcd_disk_backend_commit_duration_seconds
metrics.notes: Backend (boltdb) commit latency. High values cause slow reads and compaction issues

metrics.name: etcd_network_peer_sent_failures_total
metrics.notes: Network send failures between etcd peers. Indicates network partitions or peer unavailability

metrics.name: etcd_network_peer_round_trip_time_seconds
metrics.notes: RTT between etcd peers. High latency causes slow commits and leader elections

metrics.name: etcd_mvcc_db_total_size_in_bytes
metrics.notes: Total size of etcd database. Default quota is 2GB; approaching quota triggers alarms and blocks writes

metrics.name: container_cpu_usage_seconds_total
common_promql_patterns: sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!=""}[5m])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu"})
metrics.notes: Cumulative CPU time consumed. Use rate() for utilization. Exclude empty container label to avoid cgroup aggregates. Primary saturation metric

metrics.name: container_cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total
common_promql_patterns: sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total[5m])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[5m]))
metrics.notes: CPU throttling time due to CFS quota. Non-zero indicates CPU limits are constraining workload

metrics.name: container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total
metrics.notes: Number of throttled CFS periods. High ratio to total periods indicates severe CPU constraint

metrics.name: container_memory_usage_bytes
metrics.notes: Current memory usage including cache. May exceed working_set. Use working_set_bytes for OOM risk

metrics.name: container_memory_working_set_bytes
metrics.notes: Working set = total usage minus inactive file cache. This is what kubelet uses for OOM decisions. Primary memory metric

metrics.name: container_memory_rss
metrics.notes: Resident Set Size - anonymous memory that cannot be reclaimed. Core memory metric

metrics.name: container_memory_cache
metrics.notes: Page cache memory. Can be reclaimed under pressure. High cache is usually not a problem

metrics.name: container_memory_swap
metrics.notes: Swap usage. Non-zero indicates memory pressure. Many K8s setups disable swap entirely

metrics.name: container_oom_events_total
metrics.notes: OOM kill events. Any occurrence indicates memory limits are too low or memory leak

metrics.name: container_network_receive_bytes_total
metrics.notes: Network bytes received. Primary network ingress metric

metrics.name: container_network_transmit_bytes_total
metrics.notes: Network bytes transmitted. Primary network egress metric

metrics.name: container_network_receive_errors_total
metrics.notes: Network receive errors. Non-zero indicates network or driver issues

metrics.name: container_network_transmit_errors_total
metrics.notes: Network transmit errors. Non-zero indicates network or driver issues

metrics.name: container_fs_usage_bytes
metrics.notes: Filesystem usage by container. Important for ephemeral storage limits

metrics.name: container_fs_reads_bytes_total
metrics.notes: Filesystem read throughput

metrics.name: container_fs_writes_bytes_total
metrics.notes: Filesystem write throughput. High write rates may cause disk pressure

metrics.name: container_start_time_seconds
metrics.notes: Container start timestamp. Use changes() to detect restarts, or compare to now for uptime

metrics.name: rest_client_requests_total
metrics.notes: HTTP requests from K8s components to API server. Common across all controllers

metrics.name: kubernetes_build_info
metrics.notes: Version info for K8s components. Useful for detecting version skew across cluster
